title: Phrasal verbs
about: Basic phrasal verbs: a verb + a small word like up, on, off or down. Get up, get on and off a bus, turn the TV on, off, up and down, put on and take off clothes, and phrasal verbs with two meanings.

parts.title: Tip: your phrasal verb page
parts.note: Заведи в зошиті окрему сторінку для фразових дієслів. Записуй туди всі, які бачиш або чуєш, і розкладай їх на групи, як тобі зручно: одяг, транспорт, техніка, рух. І запам'ятай порядок слів: іменник може стояти до або після частки (put on your coat / put your coat on), а займенники it, them — тільки посередині (put it on, а не put on it). З get on / get off так не можна: частка завжди перед словом — get on the bus, get off it.

rows: Put your scarf on. Take your boots off.
get on, get off, take off
Get on at the first stop and get off at the last one.
turn on, turn off, turn up, turn down
Come on, get up! Breakfast is ready.
She went off to the shop. We went on talking.

items.meaning: get out of bed after sleeping
items.example: I **get up** at half past six on school days.
more: On Sundays we **get up** late and have pancakes for breakfast.
Grandad **got up** early to work in the garden.
items.watchOut: Вставати з ліжка — get up, а не stand up. Stand up — підвестися, наприклад зі стільця. І не плутай з wake up — прокидатися: I woke up at six, but I got up at seven.

items.pattern: get on the bus / train / plane / bike
items.meaning: go into a bus, train or plane; sit on a bike
items.uk: сідати (в автобус, потяг, літак; на велосипед)
items.example: Hurry up and **get on** the train! The doors are closing.
more: Show your ticket to the driver when you **get on** the bus.
We **got on** the plane and found our seats.
items.watchOut: Сісти в автобус — get on the bus, а не sit in the bus. А в машину чи таксі — get in / get into the car. Частка завжди перед словом: get on the bus, get on it.

items.pattern: get off the bus / train / plane / bike
items.meaning: leave a bus, train or plane; come down from a bike
items.uk: виходити (з автобуса, потяга, літака); злазити (з велосипеда)
items.example: We **got off** the bus near the zoo.
more: **Get off** the tram at the next stop and turn left.
He **got off** his bike and pushed it up the hill.
items.watchOut: Вийти з автобуса — get off the bus, а не go out of the bus. З машини чи таксі — get out of the car.

items.pattern: turn on the TV · turn the TV on · turn it on
items.meaning: make a light or machine start working
items.example: Can you **turn on** the light? I can't see anything.
more: She **turned** the radio **on** and listened to the news.
Dad **turned on** the washing machine before he went to work.
items.watchOut: Займенник — тільки посередині: turn it on, а не turn on it. З іменником можна і так, і так: turn on the TV / turn the TV on. Не open і не include the light. У Британії ще кажуть put the light / the TV on — це теж правильно.

items.pattern: turn off the light · turn the light off · turn it off
items.meaning: make a light or machine stop working
items.example: Please **turn off** your phones before the film starts.
more: **Turn** the light **off** when you go to bed.
Mum **turned off** the TV and said, 'Time for homework!'
items.watchOut: Не exclude the light (від «виключити») і не close the TV. Вимкнути — turn off (або switch off). Займенник посередині: turn it off, а не turn off it.

items.pattern: turn up the TV / radio / music · turn it up
items.meaning: make a TV, radio or music louder
items.example: The match is starting! **Turn up** the TV, please.
more: We can't hear the radio in the kitchen. Can you **turn** it **up**?
My brother **turned up** the music and started dancing.
items.watchOut: Turn up — голосніше, turn down — тихіше. Займенник посередині: turn it up, а не turn up it.

items.pattern: turn down the TV / radio / music · turn it down
items.meaning: make a TV, radio or music quieter
items.example: I'm on the phone. Can you **turn down** the TV, please?
more: This film is very loud. Let's **turn** it **down** a little.
Mum **turned down** the radio to hear the doorbell.
items.watchOut: Не плутай: turn down — тихіше, turn off — вимкнути зовсім. Займенник посередині: turn it down, а не turn down it.

items.example: After the break, the teacher asked us to **go on** reading.
more: We were tired, but we **went on** walking to the top of the hill.
That's a great story! Please **go on**.
items.watchOut: Після go on у значенні «продовжувати» — дієслово з -ing: went on reading. Не плутай з go out — вийти (з дому, на вулицю).

items.meaning: leave a place and go somewhere else
items.example: The children **went off** to the beach, and we stayed at the hotel.
more: She said goodbye and **went off** to catch her train.
Where's Max? — He **went off** with his friends an hour ago.
items.watchOut: Go off має й інші значення: My alarm went off — задзвонив будильник; The milk has gone off — молоко зіпсувалося. У цьому юніті go off — піти, поїхати.

items.pattern: put on your coat · put your coat on · put it on
items.meaning: start wearing clothes, shoes or a hat
items.example: Your hands are cold. **Put on** your gloves.
more: She **put** her trainers **on** and went for a run.
This jumper is too small. I can't **put** it **on**.
items.watchOut: Займенник — тільки посередині: put it on, put them on (не put on it). З іменником можна обидва варіанти: put on your coat / put your coat on. Не dress your coat: dress — одягати когось (dress the baby), а одягнутися — get dressed.

items.pattern: Come on! (to make sb hurry or try harder)
items.meaning: said when you want someone to hurry or to try harder
items.example: **Come on**! The film starts in ten minutes.
more: **Come on**, Anna! You can run faster than that!
**Come on**, kids! Shoes on, the taxi is here.
items.watchOut: Come on — це вигук «Давай! Швидше!», а не «приходь». Щоб покликати когось до себе, кажуть Come here.

items.pattern: turn down an invitation / an offer / a job · turn it down
items.meaning: say no to something someone offers you
items.example: I **turned down** Ben's invitation to the cinema. I had a test the next day.
more: The school offered him a place in the team, but he **turned** it **down**.
My aunt offered me a lift, but I **turned** it **down**. I wanted to walk.
items.watchOut: Відмовитися від чогось — turn sth down, без from: turned down the job (не turned down from). Займенник посередині: turn it down. Це те саме turn down, що й «зробити тихіше», — значення видно з контексту.

items.meaning: (about a plane) leave the ground and start flying
items.example: Our plane **takes off** at ten, so we must leave home at seven.
more: The plane **took off** an hour late because of the fog.
I always feel a bit scared when the plane **takes off**.
items.watchOut: Злітати — take off, а не fly up. Протилежне — land (приземлятися).

items.pattern: take off your shoes · take your shoes off · take them off
items.meaning: remove clothes, shoes or a hat from your body
items.example: In many homes, people **take off** their shoes at the door.
more: **Take** your coat **off** and sit down. Would you like some tea?
Your hat is wet. **Take** it **off** and dry it on the radiator.
items.watchOut: Протилежне до put on. Займенник посередині: take them off, а не take off them. Не put off — це «відкладати». Роззуватися — take off your shoes, а не undress (undress — роздягатися).

warmup.explain: Вставати з ліжка — get up. Stand up — підвестися, наприклад зі стільця.

warmup.uk: Ми сіли в автобус біля школи.
warmup.q: We ___ the bus near the school.
warmup.explain: Сісти в автобус чи потяг — get on. Sit — це просто сидіти.

warmup.uk: Виходь з автобуса на наступній зупинці.
warmup.q: ___ the bus at the next stop.
warmup.explain: Вийти з автобуса, потяга — get off. Go out — вийти з дому, піти гуляти.
Вмикати — turn on. Include — включати до списку, а не вмикати світло.
Надягати — put on. Dress — одягати когось (dress the baby).
Знімати одяг, взуття — take off. Put off — відкладати, undress — роздягатися.
Відмовитися від чогось — turn down (або refuse), без from.

A.q: The radio is too loud for Grandad. Can you ___, please?
A.explain: Тихіше — down, голосніше — up. Займенник it стоїть посередині: turn it down.

A.q: We're on the bus, and this is our stop. Let's ___.
A.explain: Вийти з автобуса чи потяга — get off. Go out — вийти з дому, піти гуляти.

A.q: The phone rang, but Grandma ___ cooking.
A.explain: Go on + -ing — продовжувати щось робити: went on cooking.

B.q: The plane ___ at 9.15 and landed in Paris at 11.
B.explain: Літак злітає — takes off, приземляється — lands.

B.q: It was warm in the café, so I ___ my coat.
B.explain: Знімати одяг — take off. Put off означає «відкладати на потім».

B.q: Sara asked me to join her chess club, but I ___ the invitation.
B.explain: Turn down an invitation — відмовитися від запрошення. Turn off — вимкнути, turn up — зробити голосніше.

example.title: Grandma's visit
example.uk:
У суботу я встав о сьомій. Було холодно, тож я вдягнув теплу куртку. «Швидше!» — сказав тато. Ми сіли в автобус і вийшли біля аеропорту. Ми дивилися, як злітають літаки. Нарешті прилетіла бабуся!

Удома бабуся зняла пальто й сіла. Я вимкнув телевізор, і вона розповіла нам про свою подорож. Було дуже цікаво, тож ми сказали: «Розповідай далі, будь ласка!»
example.en:
On Saturday I [[got up|a1]] at seven. It was cold, so I [[put on|a10]] my warm jacket. '[[Come on|a11]]!' Dad said. We [[got on|a2]] the bus and [[got off|a3]] at the airport. We watched the planes [[take off|b2]]. At last, Grandma arrived!

At home, Grandma [[took off|b3]] her coat and sat down. I [[turned off|a5]] the TV, and she told us about her trip. It was very interesting, so we said, 'Please [[go on|a8]]!'
